title: 006 不稳定的结盟007 杀人与逮捕

006 不稳定的结盟
轻视将招致灭亡！
张警虽然读书只读到初中，但人却并不笨，反而相当的精明。
金沙滩只要没过午夜一点，基本上都是热闹非凡的，张警并没有贸然进入人群之中，毕竟他也知道自己的身体正无时无刻不在散发着让人难以忍受的气味。
在金沙滩外围走了一会，忽然他看到了一个黑人，他眼睛顿时亮了起来，嘴角露出隐秘的微笑，立即尾随在黑人身后。
这黑人穿着很随意，而且并没有携带武器，张警不断的观察这黑人。
他却不知道，远处有人发现了他和黑人，准确一点讲，是发现了黑人，而他只是附带。
关雨此时在自行车旁边，看着远处的黑人，幸好灯光不错，他发现了黑人的踪迹，没想到刚刚跟丢了，放弃的时候却是柳暗花明！
“有古怪。”关雨看到流浪汉和黑人，心里顿时觉得不对劲，将钥匙重新放回口袋，然后立即跟上。
三人就这样一前一后的行走，渐渐进入了一条无人的小巷。
这小巷四通八达，但此时却人迹罕至，无论是张警还是关雨都是第一次来到这里。
只见那黑人忽然加速跑了起来，张警顿时赶紧跟上，关雨想了一下，也远远的跟着。
关雨估计那黑人已经发现了流浪汉，毕竟流浪汉身上那股味，就算他隔着很远都能够闻到，那黑人怎么可能发现不了。
而他拥有低调勋章，而且身上穿着与夜色相符的黑色大衣，行为也从未高调过，对方估计还没发现他。
追上去，一转角他就发现黑人已经和流浪汉交手了，那流浪汉手里拿着水果刀，而黑人手里则拿着一把狗腿刀。
两人此时正在对峙，两边竟然都没有露出恐惧的表情。
“你为什么跟着我？？”黑人用生涩的中文喝问道。
张警呼吸有点急促，他还是第一次遇到这种状况，他亲眼看到黑人忽然手里多了一把狗腿刀。
他不是脑残，自然知道这意味着什么。
“你也是内侧的游戏玩家吧，你的任务是什么？”张警喘着气开口问道。

关雨听到这话，顿时瞳孔收缩，这两个人竟然和他一样是内侧的游戏玩家，看来事情有点复杂了。
“幸好我有低调勋章，不过还是要小心一点，那老外应该是外国国籍，而这流浪汉应该是我们这边的人，等一下或许可以接触一下。”关雨心里不断的思考着对策。
黑人显然有点惊讶，但随即冷笑道：“当然是……”
忽然他快速靠近，对着张警就是一刀，不过流浪汉十分的警惕，立即用水果刀挡下。
好歹也曾经搬过砖，张警的力气明显在黑人之上。
这时候黑人却出其不意的一拳打在张警的脸上，张警鼻侧被砸到顿时流血不止，张警退后两步，而黑人立即紧追过来，举起手上的狗腿刀就向下劈向张警。
张警顿时大惊，赶紧侧身避开，他很擅长一招特殊的技巧，就是蹲下向前转身，刺击敌人的腰部！
此时他就头低下，也不顾一直流出的鼻血，身体一转，水果刀就刺向黑人的腰部。
黑人吓了一跳，身体弓起后退，险而又险的避开张警的致命一击，这时候黑人面色狰狞，立即举起手上的狗腿刀想要劈向张警。
忽然一支箭矢飞来，不过准头似乎不太好，落在了一旁的树上面。不过却将黑人惊吓住，黑人一抬头只见一个头上面带着骷髅金属面具的男子手里拿着弓箭，箭矢正对着他。
“狗屎！”黑人骂了一句，赶紧和张警拉开距离。
关雨这时候开口道：“站住！”
他之所以出手，自然是不想张警被杀死，因为现在这个城市越混乱，对他就越有利。
他不担心两人会对他造成影响，因为他此时在暗处，对方在明处，况且他的装备也比黑人和流浪汉要好的多。
张警和黑人此时都看着关雨，面上露出惊惧的表情，这个人如果想要干掉他们的话，后果不敢想象。
“你们都是玩家吧？”关雨开口道。
黑人和张警又是一惊，显然没想到这次居然又遇到一个玩家，今天晚上还真是一个奇妙的夜晚。
“不说话，我就当做默认了。”关雨淡淡的说道。
黑人这时候用蹩脚的中文道：“维克多那老混球是你杀的吧？”
“没错。”关雨淡淡的说道。

张警这时候也冷静下来，道：“兄弟，能不能先把弓箭放下，这样我们压力很大啊。”
“OK。”关雨点头将弓箭收入背包，下一刻唐刀出现在他手上，无论是黑人还是张警顿时都额头冒汗，这家伙绝对是危险度极高的变态。
关雨慢慢靠近张警，对两人说道：“其实我们并没有矛盾，我们都是玩家，内侧任务大家想必都一样吧？”
“我是杀十个不同阵营的人！”张警说道。
黑人也点头道：“我也是一样。”
“那就对了，我们的任务并没有矛盾的地方，为什么要敌对，况且既然我们都是玩家，应该可以想象出来吧，不久的将来，某位和我们一样的玩家，任务失败了，惩罚是变成丧尸，随着丧尸数量的增加，那时候就是世界末日的开始！”关雨缓缓的说道。
黑人和张警刚刚还在拼命，现在却退到了一起，两人互视一眼，张警开口道：“这只是其中一个可能吧？”
“对，这确实是其中一个可能性，不过我认为这个可能性却高达百分之九十。”关雨故意夸大几率，却用极其自信的语气说道。
黑人和张警听了关雨自信的言论，心里都有些相信，毕竟他们也不认为所有的玩家都可以完成任务。
“你们……都不想成为任务失败的那一位吧？”关雨终于露出自己真正的目的！
黑人和张警同时点头，大家出来混，当然是想要完成任务。
“那就对了，我们实质上都没有冲突，所以我们具备合作的前提条件。”关雨嘴角露出得逞的微笑，不过他头戴着骷髅面具，黑人和张警都看不见。
张警这时候开口道：“怎么合作？”
“例如情报共享、杀人同步，杀人的手法互相配合。”关雨淡淡的说道。
情报共享，这是他目前最需要的，例如黑人的话，肯定知道一些老外的住处和身份，同时他们在什么地方杀过人，也必须知道。
而杀人同步和手法配合则是为了迷惑警方，这样一来，警方的破案能力自然就下降了。
“两位觉得如何？”关雨见两人在思考，缓缓说道。
黑人和张警都有点意动，确实大家没有冲突，不过这骷髅人却让他们有些担心和不信任。
一个忽然出现的骷髅人，身上的装备还十分的齐全，这样的家伙，危险程度太高了，如果他居心不良的话，他们十有八九会死掉。
“如果你们担心我会对你们不利的话，你们现在可以试着合作攻击我，我会让你们明白……杀你们，我不需要阴谋诡计！”关雨看出两人的犹豫，开口说道。

黑人和张警互视一眼，不约而同的出手！
他们其实也想知道眼前骷髅人的实力，不然骷髅人就像是隐藏在迷雾中的毒蛇，太可怕了。
黑人立即举起狗腿刀劈向关雨，而张警则伸手刺向关雨的喉咙。
关雨立即退后，唐刀直接劈向黑人，黑人赶紧回守，用狗腿刀格挡。
不过下一刻他就面色剧变，狗腿刀脱手，唐刀已经离他的脖子只有几厘米。
张警看到这一幕，直接傻眼了。
黑人的虎口此时鲜血直流，他很清楚刚刚如果这骷髅人要杀他，他绝对没有任何反抗的能力。
力量太可怕了！
虽然骷髅人武器上面占了一定的优势，但最可怕的还是那恐怖的力量!
“现在我们能够坐下来谈谈了吗？”关雨收起唐刀，开口说道。
黑人和张警都沉默的点头，面对眼前的骷髅人，完全没胜算，脑残才会忤逆他的意志。
三人直接在金沙滩不远处停下，三人面对面的坐着，黑人和张警都看着关雨。
“首先自我介绍一下吧，你们可以叫我零，目前已经干掉两个目标。”关雨淡淡的说道，零就是他的ID，他也是顺口就将这作为自己的代号。
黑人想了想，道：“我叫佐汉，目前干掉了一个目标！”
“我叫张警，目前干掉了一个目标。”张警开口道。
关雨想了想，道：“你们的ID是多少？”
“312。”佐汉回答道。
张警开口道：“581。”
“……”关雨心里略微有些吃惊，他的ID是0，而佐汉和张警的ID却是三位数以上，也就是说这几天成为玩家的人最少也有五百以上！
五百人，听起来很多，但如果将这些人分散到全世界却并不算太多，但五百人如果有一半以上的人失败成为丧尸分散在世界各地，那么世界末日的到来几乎是必定的事实！

况且，张警的ID未必是最后，或许后面还有更多的人，一千或者一万！
content_en:
006 Unstable alliance
Contempt will lead to destruction!
Although Police Zhang only went to junior high school, he is not stupid, but rather smart.
As long as it's not past midnight, the Golden Beach is basically bustling with activity. Officer Zhang did not rush into the crowd. After all, he also knew that his body was exuding an unbearable smell all the time.
After walking around the golden beach for a while, he suddenly saw a black man. His eyes suddenly lit up, a secret smile appeared on his lips, and he immediately followed the black man.
The black man was dressed casually and was not carrying any weapons. Officer Zhang kept observing the black man.
Little did he know that someone in the distance spotted him and the black man. To be more precise, he discovered the black man, and he was just incidental.
Guan Yu was next to the bicycle at this time, looking at the black man in the distance. Fortunately, the light was good, and he found the trace of the black man. Unexpectedly, he had lost track of the black man just now, but when he gave up, it became clear!
"There's something weird." Guan Yu suddenly felt something was wrong when he saw the homeless man and the black man. He put the key back into his pocket and followed immediately.
The three of them walked in tandem and gradually entered a deserted alley.
This alley is connected in all directions, but it is deserted at this time. It is the first time for both Police Officer Zhang and Guan Yu to come here.
The black man suddenly sped up and ran. Officer Zhang immediately followed him. Guan Yu thought for a moment and followed from a distance.
Guan Yu estimated that the black man had discovered the homeless man. After all, he could smell the smell of the homeless man even from a long distance away. How could the black man not notice it?
And he has a low-profile medal, and he is wearing a black coat that matches the night. His behavior has never been high-profile, and the other party probably hasn't noticed him yet.
When he chased after him, he turned a corner and found that the black man was already fighting with the homeless man. The homeless man was holding a fruit knife in his hand, while the black man was holding a dogleg knife in his hand.
The two were confronting each other at this time, and neither of them showed any expressions of fear.
"Why are you following me??" the black man asked in jerky Chinese.
Officer Zhang's breathing was a little short. This was the first time he encountered this situation. He saw with his own eyes that the black man suddenly had a dog-leg knife in his hand.
He is not stupid and naturally knows what this means.
"You are also a game player on the inside, right? What is your mission?" Officer Zhang asked breathlessly.
When Guan Yu heard this, his pupils suddenly contracted. These two people were actually gamers on the inside like him. It seemed that things were a bit complicated.
"Fortunately, I have a low-key medal, but I still have to be careful. The foreigner should be of foreign nationality, and the homeless man should be from our side. Maybe we can get in touch later." Guan Yu kept thinking about countermeasures in his mind.
The black man was obviously a little surprised, but then sneered: "Of course..."
Suddenly, he approached quickly and stabbed Police Officer Zhang, but the homeless man was very vigilant and immediately blocked it with a fruit knife.
After all, he has moved bricks before, and Police Zhang is obviously stronger than the black people.
At this time, the black man unexpectedly punched Officer Zhang in the face. Officer Zhang was hit on the side of his nose and immediately started to bleed. Officer Zhang took two steps back, and the black man immediately chased after him. He raised the dog-leg knife in his hand and slashed downwards at Officer Zhang.
Officer Zhang was immediately startled and quickly turned sideways to avoid it. He was very good at a special technique, which was to squat down, turn forward, and stab the enemy in the waist!
At this time, he lowered his head, ignoring the nosebleed that kept flowing out. As soon as he turned his body, he stabbed the black man in the waist with the fruit knife.
The black man was startled, and he arched his body and retreated, narrowly avoiding Police Zhang's fatal blow. At this time, the black man looked ferocious and immediately raised the dog-leg knife in his hand to strike at Police Zhang.
Suddenly an arrow flew over, but its accuracy seemed not very good, and it landed on a tree nearby. However, the black man was frightened. When he looked up, he saw a man with a skull on his head.The man in the metal mask held a bow and arrow in his hand, and the arrow was pointed at him.
"Shit!" the black man cursed and quickly distanced himself from Officer Zhang.
Guan Yu said at this time: "Stop!"
The reason why he took action was naturally that he didn't want police officer Zhang to be killed, because the more chaotic the city is now, the more beneficial it is to him.
He was not worried that the two of them would affect him, because he was in the dark and the other party was in the open, and his equipment was much better than that of the black man and the homeless man.
Officer Zhang and the black man were both looking at Guan Yu with frightened expressions on their faces. If this man wanted to kill them, the consequences would be unimaginable.
"Are you all players?" Guan Yu said.
The black man and Police Zhang were shocked again. Obviously they didn't expect to meet another player this time. It was really a wonderful night tonight.
"If you don't speak, I'll take it as my acquiescence." Guan Yu said calmly.
At this time, the black man said in broken Chinese: "You killed that old bastard Victor, right?"
"That's right." Guan Yu said calmly.
Officer Zhang also calmed down at this time and said: "Brother, can you put down the bow and arrow first? This will put us under great pressure."
"OK." Guan Yu nodded and put the bow and arrow into his backpack. The next moment, Tang Dao appeared in his hand. Both the black man and Police Officer Zhang suddenly had sweat on their foreheads. This guy is definitely a very dangerous pervert.
Guan Yu slowly approached Police Zhang and said to the two of them: "Actually, we have no conflict. We are all players. We must all have the same internal tasks, right?"
"I'm going to kill ten people from different camps!" Officer Zhang said.
The black man nodded and said, "Me too."
"That's right, there is no contradiction in our mission, why should we be hostile? Besides, since we are all players, we should be able to imagine that in the near future, a player like us will fail the mission, and the punishment will be to become a zombie. As the number of zombies increases, that will be the beginning of the end of the world!" Guan Yu said slowly.
The black man and Officer Zhang were still fighting for their lives just now, but now they retreated together. The two looked at each other, and Officer Zhang said, "Is this just one of the possibilities?"
"Yes, this is indeed one of the possibilities, but I think the possibility is as high as 90%." Guan Yu deliberately exaggerated the odds, but said in an extremely confident tone.
After hearing Guan Yu's confident remarks, Black Man and Officer Zhang both believed it. After all, they didn't think all players could complete the mission.
"You... don't want to be the one who fails the mission, right?" Guan Yu finally revealed his true purpose!
The black man and police officer Zhang nodded at the same time. Everyone came out to hang out, of course they wanted to complete the mission.
"That's right, we actually have no conflict, so we have the prerequisites for cooperation." A successful smile appeared on Guan Yu's lips, but he was wearing a skull mask, so neither the black man nor the police officer could see him.
At this time, Police Officer Zhang said: "How to cooperate?"
"For example, intelligence sharing, synchronization of killings, and coordinated killing techniques." Guan Yu said calmly.
Intelligence sharing is what he needs most at the moment. For example, black people must know the residence and identity of some foreigners. At the same time, they must also know where they have killed people.
The synchronization of killings and coordination of techniques are to confuse the police. As a result, the police's ability to solve crimes will naturally decrease.
"What do you two think?" Guan Yu said slowly, seeing the two of them thinking.
The black man and Police Officer Zhang were both a little moved. It was true that there was no conflict between them, but the skeleton made them a little worried and distrustful.
A skeleton man suddenly appeared with complete equipment. Such a guy was too dangerous. If he had bad intentions, they would most likely die.
"If you are worried that I will be harmful to you, you can try to cooperate to attack me now, and I will let you understand...I don’t need any conspiracy to kill you! Guan Yu saw the hesitation of the two people and said.
The black man and Police Officer Zhang looked at each other and took action in unison!
In fact, they also wanted to know the strength of the skeleton in front of them, otherwise the skeleton would be like a poisonous snake hidden in the fog, which would be too scary.
The black man immediately raised his dog-leg knife and struck Guan Yu, while Officer Zhang reached out and stabbed Guan Yu in the throat.
Guan Yu immediately retreated, and the Tang knife struck directly at the black man. The black man quickly returned to guard and blocked with the dog-leg knife.
But the next moment, his expression changed drastically, and the dog-leg knife was released. The Tang knife was only a few centimeters away from his neck.
Police Zhang was dumbfounded when he saw this scene.
The black man's tiger's mouth was bleeding profusely. He knew very well that if the skeleton wanted to kill him just now, he would have absolutely no ability to resist.
The power is terrible!
Although the skeletons have certain advantages in weapons, the most terrifying thing is the terrifying power!
"Can we sit down and talk now? "Guan Yu put away the Tang Dao and said.
The black man and Police Officer Zhang both nodded silently. Facing the skeleton in front of them, they had no chance of winning. Only those with brains would disobey his will.
The three of them stopped directly not far from the golden beach. The three of them sat face to face. Both the black man and police officer Zhang looked at Guan Yu.
"First of all, let me introduce myself. You can call me Zero. I have killed two targets so far. "Guan Yu said lightly, zero is his ID, and he casually took this as his code name.
The black man thought for a while and said: "My name is Zohan, and I have killed a target so far! "
"My name is Police Zhang, and I have killed a target so far. "Jing Zhang said.
Guan Yu thought for a while and said: "What is your ID? "
"312. " Zohan replied.
Officer Zhang said: "581. "
"..." Guan Yu was a little surprised. His ID was 0, while Zuo Han and Zhang Jing's IDs were more than three digits. This means that there are at least 500 players who have become players in the past few days!
Five hundred people sounds like a lot, but if these people are scattered around the world, it is not too much. But if more than half of the five hundred people fail and become zombies scattered around the world, then the end of the world is almost certain!
Besides, Officer Zhang’s ID may not be the last, there may be more people behind him, one thousand or ten thousand!
